lines.english: "I bought you a bento."
"Two plain bento boxes… how unimaginative of you."
"I had no choice, everything else was almost sold out."
"If everything is almost sold out, then there were still some left, right? Couldn't you at least have bought two different sorts instead of buying two of the same thing?"
"Who cares about the station bentos? …None of them taste particularly good anyway."
"No, Haruki… you don't understand the true spirit of vacation at all."
"I don't?"
"We're supposed to peek into each other's bentos, feel jealous of each other, then we'd enjoy our meal while exchanging our pieces."
"…Since when did you start thinking of adorable things like that?"
"Listen, we aren't just touring around, you know. We can't have a fun vacation without thinking spontaneously about how to have fun."
"I get that, but…"
"Well, since you've already bought, there is nothing we can do now. Pay more attention next time, okay?"
"…Got it. I'm sorry."
"Also, here's the drink. I barely found any at all, so I had to check even the stalls at the deepest end."
"…Why are they both MAX Coffee!?"
"Because it tastes good, why else?"
"Do you want to have a fun trip or not!? How the hell does this go well with a bento?"
Just like I promised yesterday, we left as soon as the sky grew bright… or at least that was the plan.
It was a given that Kazusa wouldn't be prepared at all, but even I myself didn't have anything prepared when I woke up. Even though I would usually take care of things like that the day before.
…We were too busy making love, after all.
"I'll make you some Tsukemono, so give me dessert."
"I'm worried about my blood pressure, so I'll pass. You should be worried about your blood sugar level too."
"And here I was trying to do something even the slightest bit fun… but then people like you…"
"Ah, this nimono is pretty good…"
Not just that, we've wasted hour after hour since we first departed, and it's now past noon.
First, we missed the express train when we were looking for the transfer platform. We also ended up at the wrong station, and had to go back one station.
Normally, I would check all the schedules in advance to find the shortest and most efficient route…
But today, we have thrown all ideas of efficiency out the window.
"As long as we're there by today" is what we decided on.
We have plenty of time. There is no set time limit for this trip meant for just the two of us.
Because… we promised to always be together.
Even when the concert ends, even when there is no reason for us to be together anymore, always…
As the tall buildings grow fewer in number on the other side of the window, more and more plantations and rice paddies become visible, letting us know that we're now in the countryside.
We have changed trains three times already since we took off from Minami-Suetsugu, and it's been about an hour since we left Tokyo.
"Want some frozen oranges?"
"…How can you buy that in this cold?"
One way or another, we make it closer to our destination, buying nostalgic snacks from the stalls at every station the train stops at.
"Do you want it or not?"
"I don't. I'll ruin my stomach if I eat something that cold right now."
In more ways than one, I feel exalted, impatient, excited and weary about this haphazard trip.
And I keep all those mixed, complex feelings closed off in my heart.
"Then feed me."
"Huh…?"
But I try to act like I'm having as much fun as I can, so those feelings don't become apparent to Kazusa.
…Because I actually am having fun.
"Peel off the skin. Then, with one piece in your hand say, 'aahn.'"
"Like… I'd do that."
"What a chicken… This is why I can't stand Japanese people. Back in the west, they even kiss on the train like it's nothing."
"I'm not getting embarrassed, just so you know! I just don't want to touch that cold thing when I'm already this cold! If you want to eat it, then do it yourself, okay?"
…In complete contrast to my emotions, Kazusa is acting more assertive than ever, even though we're in public.
"Are you telling a pianist whose precious fingers are tantamount to her own life to peel this freezing orange by herself? This is why I can't stand amateurs…"
"…Is getting your fingers cold really that bad?"
"Well, they'll turn yellow."
"…! Give me that."
And she is just as spoiled as ever.
"Here, it's peeled."
"What about the 'aahn'?"
"Eat it."
"You're back to being selfish again…"
"What's wrong with that?"
"…Aahn."
"Ahm…"
She's behaving like a carp who just saw treats being thrown into the water… Maybe I'm stretching it with these metaphors.
"Nhm, npm… nhm."
"H-Hey…"
Though I can almost consider that expression as accurate as any, because Kazusa put my fingers in her mouth with an unbelievable vigor.
"Nhm, nh… it's cold."
"That's what I told you."
"Another."
"You're going to get sick, you know."
"Just shut up and peel it. All you have to do is say 'aahn.'"
Does she have a fetish for humiliating others in public?
"Quickly, quickly."
"A-Aahn… uwah!?"
"Nhm, nh… chpm… ah, nhm… nm."
…I was naive to think that feeding her would be the most humiliating part.
"Chuhmm… Haah, aahmu… haah… haah… another one…"
"…Hey."
She's doing this on purpose… guaranteed.
Her goal is no longer to eat, or to be spoiled.
"Haruki, Haruki… quickly."
"…Aahn."
"Nhmm, nchm, haah… phmmm… aah… aaah, mhm."
"Ah, ah, ah… Kazusa."
"Nphm."
"Haah… ah, haah."
Her most sinister goal is to make me feel humiliated.
"How do you like it, Haruki…? Not bad, is it?"
"K-Kazusa…"
"We'll leave it at this for now… but later, I'll be putting something else in my mouth."
"…Another one."
I'd feel less embarrassed just kissing her…
I bet the other passengers are even more annoyed by us than that previous time at the station.
"Aahn."
"Mh… ahm… ah, mmhmm… ahh… haah…"
"…Ah, ah…!"
This is much more than just being a little more assertive.
"Another one."
In front of all these people, Kazusa has already gone all out…
"Oh dear, oh dear, oh dear…"
"President."
"This is just the tiniest bit… bad."
"President…"
"Ah, I doubt a violent robbery is the reason this apartment is so messy."
"President…"
"As far as I can tell, Kazusa turned her apartment into this by herself…"
"President! So you did know where she lived!"
"Why, of course I knew. I'm both her mother and her employer. In fact, I was the one who rented this place out in the first place."
"I-In that case, you should've told me instead of hiding it! Do you have any idea how much I've been looking for her!?"
"More importantly, Miyo-chan… can you guess something by looking at the state this apartment is in?"
"Don't try to divert the conversation! You're always trying to get out of trouble like that!"
"…Ah, I'm glad you noticed. You're right, the only things scattered around are her clothes. All from this closet."
"Hey, who are you talking to?"
"Looks like she picked up her clothes in a hurry. That girl is just as bad as me at cleaning up after herself."
"Haah… fine already. So what are you saying happened?"
"Simply put… she has her clothes with her, and many days' worth of clothes at that."
"…I don't want to even imagine what that means."
"What we can postulate from this… is that Kazusa has gone on a vacation."
"You never listen to people's opinions…"
"Changing the subject… Miyo-chan, remember when I told you earlier about that time I ran away with a man right before my concert?"
"Y-Yes… but that's… eeh?"
"I guess you could say that… she truly is my daughter."
"Stop it, stop it, stop it! Stoooop it!"
"My dear Guitar-kun, what exactly are your intentions with my daughter? You do intend on taking full responsibility, don't you?"
"Kazusa."
"Kazusa, hey, Kazusa, wake up!"
"Hm? Nhmmm…"
Time passed between us that included us arguing while we had our meal, a rather intense dessert eating session, and a rather pleasant time of chatting with one another.
I gently woke her up with my right hand. She's been lying down plenty recently, but she's still pretty sleep deprived, so she leaned her head against my shoulder and fell asleep.
"You should wake up soon… Do you want some of my MAX Coffee?"
If you're wondering why I'm using my right hand, it's because my left hand is firmly entwined with hers.
"H-Huh… are we there?"
"No… there's still an hour left."
"But it's already nighttime…"
"We're inside a tunnel."
"Ah…"
She blinks a few times, takes a good look around the train, and starts waking up.

It's certainly dark on the other side of the window, which is why Kazusa thought it was nighttime, but it becomes clear that this scenery is artificial by the fact that we can see lights periodically flash by.
"Right now it's… just past 4 o'clock, still afternoon."
"Huaah… then why did you wake me up? And I was having such a nice dream."
"I see… it's good that it was a nice dream."
I heard her saying "Haruki, Haruki" over and over again in her sleep…
"If you understand, then let me have it a bit longer. While you're at it, lend me your lap."
"You can't, wake up. We're close to leaving the tunnel."
"I don't wanna. I was also close to… so close to…"
I can't say I like seeing her preferring me in her dreams over the real me.
Actually, what was she close to doing?
"Don't you understand why I just woke you up? Have you never read anything by Yasunari Kawabata?"
"Who's that? A conductor? A composer?"
"…Just shut up and look out the window! And don't look away!"
"Ah, hey! What are you doing, Haruki…? Aah, cold!"
"Look, we're out in three… two… one…"
"Stop it～! …!?"
"Told you, didn't I?"
The landscape we were greeted with was certainly a different place from the "Snow country" Yasunari wrote about…
But there was no setting sun, no blue sky, no green trees, and no exposed land to be seen out there.
Between the white sky, the white trees, and the white land… the sun itself was denied an appearance behind all the thick layers of snow.
"It's snow."
"Yes…"
It was snow.
"It's pure white."
"Yeah…"
The last time we two saw it together was that night in Strasbourg.
And the first time we saw it together was during Christmas five years ago…
The night where we weren't two, but three…
"White Album's…"
"White snow…"
Just like that time, the snow didn't gather like this in the city.
And it's precisely because it's just like the last time that we feel nostalgic and happy when we look out the window…
But also… we feel sadness, and pain.
"We came all this way… We actually came all this way."
"No, there's still a bit left… Our trip isn't over until we leave the station, get in a taxi… and make it to our destination."
We actually came.
I couldn't bring myself to contradict those words that leaked out of Kazusa.
She was the one who decided. I was the one who didn't oppose her.
This isn't an unknown land to us. Beyond that, her choice of destination is bold, and short-sighted.
I feel more and more force around my left hand, held by Kazusa's right hand.
We exchange our emotions without a word.
Feelings now different from the ones of the two who messed around together just before.
For as long as the sun is up, I could play the part of a man with common sense, when others are watching me.
But along with the shrinking of our fields of view to exclude everyone else, I find my correct self sinking with the setting sun.
And once the sun has fully set, only Kazusa and I remain in my world…
And then the man who turned his back on the world, my true self, makes its entry.
"I'll take my leave now. Call me once you are finished eating. The open-air bath will be available until 5 o'clock in the morning."
"O-Okay."
"Well then, have a nice evening."
"T-Thank you very… much."
The boiling nabe in front of us fills the room with pleasantly smelling steam.
"Let's… eat."
"Ah, okay."
Since I ate nothing but a station bento during the day, the mere smell of this delicious dish stimulates my belly immensely.
…Yet now that it's finally here, I find myself completely stiff and unable to pick up my chopsticks.
"Their food hasn't changed."
"No…"
Yes, it hasn't changed…
Sashimi, tempura, chawanmushi, nabe slightly seasoned with dashi, and in the middle, cooked chicken dumplings.
We already know this dish tastes delicious… Though perhaps I remember it tasting better than it actually did back then.
"Well then… um, itadakimasu."
"…Itadakimasu."
She was the one who decided. I was the one who didn't oppose her.
This isn't an unknown land to us. Beyond that, her choice of destination is bold, and short-sighted.
Yes, this is the same inn we spent Christmas in five years ago.
"Oh, right… want some beer?"
"Mhm… just one."
The inn that Setsuna reserved for us, the place where all three of us have powerful memories.
It's a blight on those memories, an awful betrayal, and the most despicable thing we could do to Setsuna.
Yet we couldn't avoid coming here.
Because this place is…
"Okay… what should we toast for?"
"…Us two."
This is the place Kazusa and I stopped being the proper people we were… The place the love between two people ended.
And the place where our mistakes began.
"Okay… Here's to us."
"Cheers."
"Cheers…"
"Back then, we said Merry Christmas."
"Even though it actually was a year-end party."
"The snow isn't stopping…"
"That's what you wanted, wasn't it? The snow covering the ground as far as the eye can see, and the snow falling from the sky. Here we have both aplenty."
The white scenery we saw from inside the train continued all the way here.
Whether it was through the train window, the taxi's car window, or the windows of the inn, the two of us kept looking at the thick snow as if caught in a trance.
"Want to go for another?"
"I guess so… Give me another."
"Don't you think beer is a bit underwhelming? Do you want to order some sake?"
"They don't have any Blue Hawaii here… do they?"
"…Don't forget about the season and the place you're in."
"We drank a lot back then too."
"Because you brought a bottle of champagne."
"Everyone got wasted."
"But… it was fun."
"It was only fun… for you two. I was suffering back then."
"…I'm sorry."
"Haah…"
"Are we done? Can I call them?"
"Before that… let me stay like this for a little while longer."
"Okay…"
We sat opposite to each other at first, but by the time we were finished eating and drinking, she was already snuggling up next to me.
She's been like this today ever since we got on the train… No, she's been like this the past few days from dawn till dusk.
"Hey… where do you want to go tomorrow?"
"Nowhere. I want to stay here all day."
"Got it…"
Our plans can hardly be called typical of a vacation.
But I accept it as a given, and spend the day like we always do.
"We'll check out in… two days, right?"
"I just checked, and apparently we can extend our stay as long as we want…"
"Is this inn doing alright…?"
"Well, it's pretty far away from most tourist spots, and it doesn't have any good skiing areas. I doubt anyone comes here unless the hot springs is their reason."
"You're not saying it's doing alright at all."
"But because of that… we'll be able to do pretty alright here."
"…I suppose."
"We can stay here as many days as we want… I have enough savings to…"
"Don't try to brag about your wealth in front of me. You should already know about that better than anyone."
"Yeah, but, you know… guys like bragging about things like that."
"How ridiculous… I could secure your livelihood by myself. Learn your place."
"I didn't mean it… like that."
"…Sorry, I'm not sure what you meant."
"I see…"
"Yeah…"
The sensation of Kazusa's head suddenly disappears from my shoulder.
"Are you going to… the hot springs?"
"Just a little while longer… just a little bit."
"Mhm, I see…"
"Hey, Haruki…"
"What is it?"
Kazusa looks up at me from below.
Compared to our usual behavior, this is far too frank and far too forcible of a development.
"We haven't kissed today yet."
"…We haven't?"
And her request is just as I had expected, and wanted.
"This morning we were in such a rush, we were on the train all day, and as for the evening… we've only spent it eating so far."
"Now that you say it… you're right."
"We haven't… kissed all this time."
"…I'm sorry."
"Yes, you should be sorry… mh… mhn, hah."
"Nhm… ah, aah…"
"Mhm, ah… Haruki, Haruki… hah… hah, amhn, hah, haaah…"
"Five years ago…"
"We swore to each other… that we'd have an everlasting friendship. But in the end, I destroyed it."
"It's my fault."
"Don't put all the burden on yourself… Haruki. My sins won't become any less terrible because of that."
"Kazusa…"
Like that, we avoided confronting reality with our indiscrete words…
But by merely exchanging glances, we reached another conversation based in truth.
Something that the offenders could not bring themselves to say out loud. Something painful, sorrowful… and full of joy.
"What's the matter?"
"It's… still spilling out."
"I-I see…"
By the time we were finished making love, and had gone back to the open-air bath to clean ourselves up, it was already past 3 AM.
As expected, there was no one in the men's bath nor the women's bath, so thinking that it would do no harm, I called out to Kazusa, and she timidly made her way to the men's bath.
"Uwah… I feel like I'm in someone else's body. I'm afraid of going to the toilet next time."

"…Compared to all the things I've inserted in there before, a finger would be normal."
"Ah, don't even remind me of that. I feel dizzy from embarrassment."
She continues berating me, yet there is no sign of her ever stopping to snuggle up to me.
Her wet hair and flaming cheeks touch my neck and my shoulders, and they convey the happy feeling that our hearts are connected.
It conveys that Kazusa is truly happy right now… even compared to five years ago.
"…Still, the water is nice."
"It's a bit hot though."
Back then, only our backs were touching, and our hearts were connected through Setsuna.
That's what we forced ourselves to choose.
"And the scenery is nice."
"It's pitch black though.
In Setsuna's right hand was my left hand. In Setsuna's left hand was Kazusa's right hand. That's how our friendship was given shape.
My right hand and Kazusa's left hand were left separated.
"I don't get tired just looking at it."
But now, my right hand and Kazusa's left hand are steadfastly connected.
Five years ago, Kazusa let go of Setsuna's hand, as well as my left hand…
"I'm not sure I want to go back…"
"These are such nice hot springs, with such great scenery, right? Let's enjoy ourselves more."
"No matter how many times I look, I won't get tired of this sight…"
"Aa-ah… This is the best. I don't want to go back."
I wonder if Kazusa realizes.
That the words that just leaked from her mouth are the lines of the other person who was with us five years ago.
"Who said we were going back…?"
"Haruki…"
"You don't need to think about a future so far away. We just came here today."
"Okay…"
But I'm not so dense as to point that out to her.
But neither am I decisive enough to nod at her with a smile. I can do nothing but to clumsily divert the conversation.
"We can go to the hot springs, eat delicious meals, look at the snow…"
"Sleep, and then have you do weird things to me once I wake up…"
"We can't do it as soon as we wake up. What if the hostess walks in on us when we're doing it…?"
"So that's what you're worried about…"
"We'll do it after having eaten breakfast and taken our morning baths. I think their open-air baths open again at around 10 o'clock."
"They won't be putting away our futons while we're in the bath, will they?"
"Just so you know, I told them that we're going to use the futons during the day too, so they shouldn't come in until evening."
"…How obvious of you. She probably knows what we're doing all day."
"That's nothing to be embarrassed about. There is nothing wrong with what we're doing."
"…Y-Yeah."
Perhaps those words I spoke are a terrible form of sophistry toward the world I've lived in up until now…
But perhaps the fact that I was able to say them so easily indicates that I no longer have any place in this world.
"I hope it snows tomorrow, and the day after tomorrow."
"Yeah… I hope the snow covers us to the point where we can't see anything through the window."
"I wouldn't mind being trapped by the snow. And then the trains and the cars would have to stop too."
"We can't go against nature. There is no choice, so we can stay here longer."
"I don't mind, but… for how long?"
"Well… until spring comes."
"Haha… just like the ice age. Just when I thought I could finally get out of here after three whole months, all of Japan turns to ice."
"So what? It might counteract global warming."
"Are we taking things to such extremes? Hehe… ahahah… this is ridiculous."
"It really is ridiculous, isn't it?"
For just a second, I thought about the possibility of something so ridiculous coming true.
The world being covered in snow… and with no sign of melting on the horizon.
Left with no choice, we would spend all our time here.
I found myself slightly hoping for that endless white world, that closed off world for just the two of us.
We desired each other so much that we could in all earnesty hope for something like that.
"…I think I feel a bit sleepy."
"If you fall asleep, I'll carry you to the room."
"You can carry me if you want… but don't look at my naked body."
"After all this time you're saying that?"
Like always, we are never on the same page when we speak, yet the grip of her hand on my shoulder, and that of our entwined hands is powerful enough to convey our desperation to each other.
Without words we reassure each other that we'll never let go.
Because if we let go even once, then everything will end at that exact moment…
That idea should be just a delusion, yet it won't leave my head.
"Hah, haah… aah!"

"Haah… but still, it's amazing that it's been snowing since dawn. We might actually get buried here."

Still holding on to each other, we look outside at the never-ending snow.
The snow so white it's almost hard to believe it could have ever come from that thick black cloud.
The sky is dark, the ground is bright, and nothing changes with time. Because of that, it's difficult to tell if it actually is daytime. I'm completely robbed of my perception of time.
"There's only a week left until my next concert."

"…You were the one who said we should rest, Kazusa."
Will Kazusa make it in time for her concert? If she does make it in time, will she be able to play well?
"W-Wasn't that… hours ago?"
"…Has it been that long since then?"
…Will Kazusa continue playing the piano from now on, or will she keep running away with me?
"Does the passage of time… have any meaning to us?"
And if Kazusa chooses the latter option, how am I supposed to answer her…?
"…No, it doesn't. Nmh… nphm… ah!"
"Ah, ah, aah! Uaaaahn, aah, aah, aaahn!"
I'm not going to come to any conclusion by thinking about it, and I don't want to think about it.
That's why I try to suppress the anxiety gushing from my chest by burying myself deeper into Kazusa's chest.
"You two aren't bored, are you? The snow isn't letting anyone go out."
"No, not at all. We actually came to see the snow."
"Oh, how unusual. You can see this kind of scenery no matter where you are around these parts."
"We wanted to go somewhere you could find anywhere… Actually, that was rude, I'm sorry."
Even as I chat with the hostess, Kazusa hangs her head, making things somewhat uncomfortable.
Be it a gentle regular person or a journalist, her fear of strangers is as strong as always.
…Thanks to that, her extreme introversion will become even more prominent when we're alone together.
"Ah, right, right! I was talking about it with everyone just earlier, you know, about that thing."
"That thing…?"
"That thing" happens to be an expression a certain someone's mother uses a lot, and so I have no clue what it refers to.
"This lady you have with you. She is so unbelievably pretty. So then I asked myself where I had seen her before."
"Ah, aah! It's probably… you know, who was it again…?"
"Right, right! Hmm, you know, that pianist girl. The one who held the concert a while ago."
"Aah, right, right, that girl! People keep telling me that ever since she came back to Japan."
"…Huh?"
But in an odd twist, that vagueness also serves as an excellent camouflage for when we're having dangerous conversations such as this one.
"They keep saying that she looks just like her when she takes off her glasses and lets her hair down like now… Though if you ask me, they look nothing alike."
"That's because you're always looking at her, sir. You probably know all the tiny differences."
"Personally, I think it's rude to even compare them… I mean, this girl is way more beautiful than that celebrity."
"Hey…!"
"Yes, you're right. You can't even compare them."
"…Oh, you flatter her. You just said they looked exactly alike."
"She must've gotten more beautiful thanks to bathing in our waters. Her skin is so pure white, it reminds me of snow."
"H-Hey… stop it…"
"Oh, I'm so sorry, I must've seen wrong. Maybe I was just a bit dizzy, because right now her skin is as pink as a cherry blossom."
"Ahaha, don't tease her so much. Even at the best of times she's incredibly shy."
"Oh my, to think she is both beautiful and reserved. You're so enviable, sir."
"You think so too? …We're getting married soon."
"…!? H-Haruki…?"
"Oh my, congratulations! You two really suit each other. Taking a closer look at you, sir, I can see you're a good man too."
"Why are you only vague about your compliments toward me?"
"Well, leaving that aside, allow me to extend my congratulations to your wife, as well. Be happy for many years to come, alright?"
"W-W-W…Wife…!?"
"…Calm down."
"…It seems our cherry blossom has turned more red than ever."
"W-Why… would you do that?"
"What do you mean… that?"
"Where would we ever get married? …In our dreams?"
"Even if you were trying to divert her attention from who I am, that was going too far. You really… tell some amazing lies sometimes…"
"…Haruki?"
I was careless…
The happiness I felt from being together might have numbed my mind.
"Kazusa."
"Huh?"
I bet rumors are already going around the inn. They are probably comparing the pictures from the magazines to her.
The hostess fell for my desperate attempt at a diversion, but she never looked away from Kazusa's face.
"Let's leave tomorrow morning."
"Ah…"
She knows. She has probably… no, definitely found out who Kazusa is.
In the closed off world meant for only the two of us… a tiny crack has made itself known.
Even when it became night, the snow didn't stop. It actually snowed more than during the day.
The powder snow is flying past the window perfectly horizontally.
In this pitch black room, those white grains are the only things that reflect light, vaguely illuminating Kazusa's skin, hair, and eyes.
"Tomorrow…"
"Hm?"
In the darkness, one more thing starts to reflect light. Kazusa's wet lips, as she starts moving.
"Are we going back to Tokyo?"
During dinner, we were completely silent.
We didn't drink any alcohol, we didn't snuggle, and we didn't sense the taste of the food we were eating. Instead, we just sat there stuffing our mouths in silence for 30 minutes.
But… when the hostess came and took our plates and prepared our futons, our attitudes did a complete 180.
We made love, and hurt each other more passionately, roughly, loudly, and more animal-like than we did both this morning and yesterday night.
Releasing it inside her over and over, and it was only until Kazusa passed out for a short while… that things started to get quiet again.
"We don't have a choice."
We were driven up against a wall. Kazusa's true identity was revealed.
Tomorrow, her office might come to take her. One of Youko-san's underlings might come to forcibly take her back.
No, that would actually be the best case scenario. If someone in my line of work was to get hold of this information first…
"You have to return to work soon too, don't you? …You spent an entire week just for me."
I won't be able to let Kazusa leave this room.
The meaning behind the glances the people around the inn throw at Kazusa, their secretive whispers. I fear hearing the phone connected to the front desk ringing.
My suspicions grow stronger and stronger.
I'm overwhelmed by the feeling that the rift in our world is growing larger and larger.
"That's right, I can't say any more selfish things… I have things I need to do too."
We're reaching our limit.
We're at the point where it might be impossible to look for a place where we can be alone together, no matter where and how long we search for it.
It's not in Japan, and not in our hearts, either.
"We must go back. I must go back to my piano, and you must…"
In that case, I'll…
"I don't want to…"
"Haruki…"
In the end, I still can't bring myself to give up, and await the conclusion I know is going to happen.
"What are you saying, Kazusa…? Why would we ever go home? I mean, you just said you didn't want to go home."
"I'm happy. I'm so happy you keep saying that to me, Haruki. But you…"
"I won't let anyone get in the way between us, not anyone…"
Perhaps I didn't want to listen to what she had to say next, so I interrupted her as if obstructing her.
"Let's go north… let's go even further north."
"North…?"
"Deeper into the mountains, into an even more rural hot spring… no, perhaps we'd stand out less in a big city."
"That's right, there was also that option… Why don't we take this chance to visit Sapporo? I'm sure the snow there is even prettier than over here."
"Hey, Haruki…"
"Yeah… anyway, at least we have a plan now. Let's get on the first train tomorrow. Let's check out as soon as we wake up…"
"Haruki…"
"If that's decided, then we should get some rest for today. If we don't get proper sleep, we'll be in trouble tomorrow, you know."
"Haruki!"
"Kazusa…?"
Kazusa pushes her head into my chest.
"…! Uuah…!"
She clings to me with greater force than she has ever done before, and both warm and cold drops fall down on my chest.
"You don't have to be so worried… I'm sure everything will work out."
Her fingers on both her hands dig into my shoulders.
"You… you really are…"
Through those strong pianist's fingertips, I can sense the shivering of her entire body.
I can sense her unease.
"We can be happy, you and I… I'll make you happy."
"So don't cry… There is nothing to be sad about."
That's why I wrap myself around Kazusa, caress her hair, and try to calm her down.
Until she stops shivering, until her unease disappears… until daybreak.
"Will you… make me happy?"
"Yeah, I promise. Someday, I'm sure I will…"
"I don't want it to be someday…"
"Huh…?"
"Do it right now… Right now, make me happy, even if it's just a little bit."
"What should… I do?"
I caress the corners of Kazusa's eye with my finger, and take a look at her face she had hidden to hide her tears.
Kazusa's body still hasn't stopped shaking, but it's a good sign she is able to ask such a thing of me.
"Tell me… what you said before one more time."
"What I said before…?"
"You know, what you said to the hostess, that…"
"Ah…"
"Please… I want to hear it again, even if it's a lie…"
"I never… lied."
"Huh…?"
"Let's get married. We're going to be together from now on."
"…Haruki!"
Just when I thought she had calmed down, we're back to where we started.
Kazusa's fingers dig deep into my shoulders, her entire body starts shivering, and countless teardrops fall on my chest.
"As if I'd lie… As if I'd let go of you…"
"Haruki… you, you…!"
But this time, I don't sense any feelings of unease.
"I don't want to… let what happened five years ago repeat itself…!"
"Me neither… me neither!"
The feelings that rose within and manifested were not sadnessーin fact, they were the complete opposite.
"Kazusa… I'll never let go of you again."
"Y-Yes… don't let go of me. Hold me close, just for tonight."
"Not just tonight… forever. Because we've promised, after all."
"I'm… your wife… right? I'm Kitahara Kazusa… right?"
"We'll write that on the inn's register tomorrow. You don't have to use a fake name anymore."
"Do you swear it? Do you swear to make me your wife, Haruki?"
"Yeah… in sickness and in health…"
"For good times and the bad?"
"For richer and poorer."
"To love, honor, comfort, and support…"
"And until death do us part, I swear right here to dedicate myself to you…"
"Yes… Haruki, Haruki…!"
"Yes… Kazusa… Mhm, mh… ah, aah."
We embrace and kiss each other like we're addicted.
We roll down on the two futons. One second I'm on top of her, and the other she is on top of me, yet our lips never part.
"Hah, Haruki… Mhmm, nh, nhm…! Ah, aah… more, more!"
"Aah… more… mhm, ahm… Kazusa… ah, aah…"
There is no dress, there is no tuxedo, there is no witness and there is no exchanging of rings.
Far from it, there is not even a single person to congratulate us.
"Nh, mhm… ah, ah, ah… Haruki, Please… come… ah, aahm!"
Instead, we're alone…
We exchange our vows, and hold our wedding ceremony.
"Nhm…"
"Good morning."
"Good morning. Um, is it okay if I start preparing breakfast?"
"Eh? Ah, aah… wait just a second."
The moment I open my eyes, I feel a bit disoriented from the dazzling light coming through the window.
At the same time, I realize that it's bright outside and that I've overslept.
"Hey, Kazusa, wake up! Put on your clothes!"
We… were supposed to get out of here before breakfast, before the hostess came to check on us.
Were we so tired, or so comfortable that we couldn't wake up until the sun was fully up on a winter morning?
"Huh…?"
Or rather…
"Kazusa…?"
The warmth I should have sensed next to me is gone.
"Haah… haah… haah!"
The snow that fell until last night grabs hold of my legs, and slows me down to a walk even though I'm supposed to be running.
I can't get my body properly moving despite my impatience, or perhaps my impatience is the reason.
"Aah, if it's your companion you're wondering about, she said she would go out for a walk…"
Kazusa, the shut-in of all people…
Without any regard to the fact that I would have prevented her from going outside.
"Kazusa… Kazusa!"
The people at the inn became worried at my reaction and offered to call the police, but I did everything in my power to prevent that.
Because all she did was go out for a walk early in the morning.
She just wanted to enjoy the morning air alone, because she was sick of waiting for me to wake up.
So she'll come back in a short while, and enthusiastically tell me all about the beautiful winter scenery.
…There is no reason to panic so much.
"Haah, haah, haah…! Kazusa… Kazusa… Answer me!"
…There's no way that's true. I don't know what "that" refers to, but I know that it's just not true.
Because we promised. We promised to be together forever.
In times of pain, sadness and difficulty… We settled everything last night.
There is supposed to be a bright and bountiful future expanding before us.
That's why, that's why…
"Kazusaaa!"
Don't leave my side…
"Ah… haah… haah… haah…"
"Haruki…"
I found her…
It's not like I didn't have any clues. After all, there was only one set of footprints in the snow.
Leaving the snow-covered road, onto a small mountain trail. After ascending it for ten minutes, an open plain suddenly emerges…
"Kazusa… haah… haah…"
On top of the twinkling snow bathing in the morning sun… like the motif of a painting, a woman with long, black hair stands in the middle.
"Good morning… it finally stopped snowing."
She looks at me with an awkward smile, but her gaze stays firmly on me.
"Hah, haha… hahaha! Ha, hah, haah…"
The moment I see that nostalgic face I haven't seen for many hours… I lose the strength in my whole body and almost fall down on the snow.
"What's the matter with you…? You look as though you've been worried to death about me."
"I was worried to death… Were you trying to kill me?"
"Why would you be so worried over me just going for a walk? How overprotective of me can you possibly be?"
"T-That's… you know…!"
"…Don't tell me you thought I was brooding over it or something misguided like that?"
"I didn't!"
"How suspicious… Your feet are trembling so much, and you look like you could fall down to the ground at any moment."
Kazusa looks at me with a malicious smile, and slowly comes closer to me.
"That's not true! Anyway, it's nothing, so don't come any closer!"
"You were the one who chased after me. Isn't it strange that you'd tell me not to get close?"
"Because, I only came here to tell you breakfast is ready. Don't talk nonsense."
And I get flustered to the point of stimulating Kazusa's desire to tease me. I try to keep Kazusa from getting any closer.
…So she wouldn't be able to see that I'm on the brink of tears.
"Hey, Haruki, look at me… Come on, take a good look at me, straight in the face."
"T-That's enough… you…!"
"Aha!"
"Uwah!?"
…And the moment I'm about to get angry and glare at Kazusa, punishment rains down on me from the sky for my pointless stubbornness up until now.
"As I thought, it's really cold when I touch it directly… You can handle a snowball fight, right?"
"K-Kazusa…?"
Punishment from the hands of the puppy named Kazusa, who actually feels truly happy deep down despite the fact that she isn't jumping for joy around the yard.
"Take this!"
"Wah! H-H-Hey! You… bastard…!"
"Hyah!? You little… you got it inside my clothes. That's mean, Haruki!"
"You got me good from the start! We're not even close to being even!"
"Like I care about that! It's your own fault for chasing after me with nothing but a yukata on."
"Even if you put it that way… even if you put it that way… I was worried, so what did you expect!?"
"Like I asked, why would you be worried? You still haven't answered that question, Haruki."
"Shut up! Shut up! Aah, just shut up!"
Just like that time… though I've forgotten when it was.
Just like that time, a switch has gone off inside of us.
As these unrealistic events pile up one after another in these unbelievable past few days, we laugh even though there is nothing funny.
We believe that the feelings we have are that of happiness, and we pour those feelings into the snowballs we throw at each other.
But before long, we abandon the snowballs and attack each other with our hands, and just like that, we embrace and fall down on the snow.
"Haah, haah, haah… Aah… I exhausted myself this early in the morning."
"You started it, didn't you…?"
"I'm starting to feel kind of warm… even though I'm lying on the snow."
"That's because you're wearing your coat. I'm still freezing to death over here."
"…Then, should we go back?"
"…Mh, not yet."
"Hehe…"
"Don't laugh."
We look up at the sky as we lay on the snow, and gaze at the morning sun.
With our hands firmly clasped, we feel each other's warmth, and our freezing cold fingertips.
We make sure of each other's existence in this world uninhabited by anyone but us.
"Hey, Haruki."
"Will you, will you really… stay with me from now on?"
"…Yeah."
It's an oath I swore last night, so I won't hesitate anymore.
"Will you always follow me no matter where I go…?"
"No matter where."
Kazusa's grip around my hand grows stronger.
"Even further north… or perhaps even overseas?"
"If you desire it. Because we're already…"
"Would you follow me… to hell itself?"
"Yeah, we'll be together to the ends of the earth."
"Haruki…"
"Kazusa…"
Kazusa slowly turns toward me.
With that skin white enough to blend in with the snow, and that jet black hair and those eyes that almost refuse to blend together, she radiates an almost clear beauty.
And with a voice that fits that appearance perfectly… she speaks to me in her clear voice.
"Yeah right… I refuse. I can't be with you."
